_notes: Every name UQM 0.8.0's own code gives, with the game strings (text.starcon) of the official content package (SHA-256 77d75ac25e6fb755a33c4ba3b38a7b7bc41fcbc02896891b0cc9ac9214b72eef), read by UQM's _GetStringData. Names are content (CC BY-NC-SA 2.5), so each is the SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes.

stars: one per star in starmap order. cluster: GetClusterName. planets: in PlanetDesc order, each as seen from its own inner system (after GenerateMoons, which calls generateName): name is GLOBAL_SIS (PlanetName), title GetPlanetTitle (the orbit screen's title), planet_or_moon GetPlanetOrMoonName into SIS_NAME_SIZE bytes (as the save summary does). moons: in MoonDesc order, [GetPlanetTitle, GetPlanetOrMoonName] for each.
